responsibility: Declares the data structures for per-location warning suppression. It defines nowarn_spec_t as a bitset over stable warning groups, the bitwise operations used to combine and test suppressions, and the nowarn_map_t location-to-spec mapping exposed to the rest of GCC, forming the public API companion to diagnostic-spec.cc’s suppression logic.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for per-location warning suppression: it defines nowarn_spec_t, its bitwise operators, and nowarn_map_t/nowarn_map declarations, while diagnostic-spec.cc provides the option-to-group mapping and the executable suppression-management routines.
